context: Hi. How are you?

Comedies I like best

Its about a cop recruiting an uber driver to help him catch the person who killed his partner.
Yes I recall seeing the trailer on TV...looks good. Have you seen it or want to see it?
I have seen this movie and I think you will like it. Dave Bautista looks good in this movie
Well alright I'll search on demand for it...what kinds of movies do you like best
I like action movies and comedies as well.
Skyscraper is exciting...just saw it
Very good movie. Stuber had a very good plot and a good cast.
do you go to day or evening movies
I usually go to evening movies at the movie theatre
Have you thought about working in the industry?
I did a few years back. My late father wanted me to go to Hollywood and become an actor.
Ever take him up ?
I might in the future. I never say never.
